scenario.name: r-cd-out-restart-replay
scenario.description: A published claim survives an operator gateway restart with stable claim identity and idempotent replay: one publication yields exactly one claim, and replay materializes nothing.
scenario.notes: Runnable harness, orchestration-gated verdict. The scenario logs when its restart window opens; the operator restarts the gateway during that window.

expectedReceipts.name: pre-restart-claim-established
expectedReceipts.description: CDREPLAY-PRE sentinel naming the claim id before the restart window opens

expectedReceipts.name: gateway-restart-observed
expectedReceipts.description: Externally observable gateway lifecycle change on the public /status surface (uptime reset, or endpoint drop and return) while the harness is disconnected. OPENCLAW_RESTART_ORCHESTRATED is an operator declaration and is never sufficient.

expectedReceipts.name: reconnected-after-restart
expectedReceipts.description: The harness opened a SECOND WebSocket connection after the restart window, so a real restart cannot fail the row by dropping the original socket

expectedReceipts.name: post-restart-claim-listed
expectedReceipts.description: CDREPLAY-POST sentinel observed on the reconnected socket

expectedReceipts.name: claim-identity-stable
expectedReceipts.description: The post-restart claim id equals the pre-restart claim id

expectedReceipts.name: replay-is-idempotent
expectedReceipts.description: Exactly one claim carries the row nonce after replay

expectedReceipts.name: no-duplicate-claim-after-replay
expectedReceipts.description: Negative check: replay minted no second claim and no different claim id

expectedReceipts.name: no-auto-materialize-on-replay
expectedReceipts.description: Negative check: no materialized state appeared without an explicit recipient action

expectedReceipts.name: no-raw-artifact-bytes-on-the-wire
expectedReceipts.description: Negative check: artifact content absent from every non-harness frame across replay

review.notes: Orchestration-gated. PARTIAL-candidate is the expected artifact class unless an operator restart is OBSERVED on the gateway's public /status surface while the harness is disconnected, and the reconnected socket then re-lists the same claim exactly once. The operator declaration OPENCLAW_RESTART_ORCHESTRATED is recorded but never credited as evidence.

liveRunSafety.notes: Requires an operator gateway restart inside OPENCLAW_RESTART_WINDOW_MS (default 120000). The harness never restarts anything. Set OPENCLAW_RESTART_ORCHESTRATED=true only when a restart genuinely happened.
